sourceAuthority.title: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sourceAuthority.layout: R13/R14 object bit size follows EED; R2000 size precedes the self handle. The common tail has a soft-pointer parent, soft-pointer reactors and a hard-owner extension dictionary.

scope: Extract shared version-aware framing and common handle-tail observer for the existing R13/R14 dictionary and R13/R14/R2000 MLINESTYLE source profiles. Profile-specific EED, body, entry, graph and output conditions remain separate. No new profile is admitted.

validation.release: Focused CTest: libdxfrw_dwg_ac1014_dictionaryvar, dwg2dxf_ac1012_partial_generated, dwg2dxf_ac1012_ownership_generated: 3/3 pass.
validation.controls: Generated R13/R14/R2000 framing: version size location, wrong-version, body-end bounds, wrong owner role, every byte truncation and corrected retry; existing dictionary bit mutation, EED controls, model rollback and MLINESTYLE mutation controls also pass.
validation.generatedAc1012: The existing R13 partial and ownership tests create DWGs in temporary directories; they exercise strict refusal, destination preservation, ASCII/Binary partial output, source and graph failures and retry as described by their individual assertions.
validation.fullyInstrumentedAsan: Debug library and focused dictionary test built with -fsanitize=address; 1/1 test passed.
validation.mixedInstrumentationNote: A preliminary ASan-instrumented test linked against an unsanitized library reported a container overflow in std::vector during dictionary parsing. This does not reproduce when library and test are both instrumented; the mixed run is not used as a memory-safety qualification.

limits: Generated controls do not establish native clone, duplicate, or WBLOCK semantics.
Strict AC1012 output, native consumer behavior and other unqualified object profiles remain gated.
No DWG or DXF fixture added.
